Steps.Text: Press A/D to walk around. F to use flashlight
Head to the electrical panel to do a task

Connect all the dots.
Press A/D to look left and right, Q to leave
Leave the room on the left side, look for a valve

Click and spin the valve. Stay on the green gauge! 
Press A/D to look left and right, F to use flashlight, Q to leave
Head to the ladder in the right electric room and exit.
